title: MOSS Image · Character for finetunes
blurb: A person or character that keeps its likeness on MOSS finetunes such as Serenity, not only on Base.
note: Slower than MOSS Image · Character (every block trains); use that one for Base alone
notes: Draft: a LoRA on every block's MLPs at 3e-4 reached likeness 0.59 on Base at 1500 steps on 37 photos (768 px) and kept 78% of it on Serenity v6 (0.46). The LoKr on blocks 24-41 (MOSS Image · Character) reached more on Base (0.66) but kept 61%; the same LoRA on blocks 24-41 only kept 51%, and at 1e-4 every LoRA trailed (0.49-0.52 on Base).
